content: Trends is a collection of scientific journals owned by Elsevier, focusing on publishing review articles across various fields of biology. These journals are now part of Elsevier's Cell Press group. The series began in 1976 with the launch of Trends in Biochemical Sciences (TIBS). Shortly after, other titles were introduced, including Trends in Neurosciences (TINS), Trends in Pharmacological Sciences (TIPS), and Immunology Today. During the 1980s and 1990s, the series expanded to include non-biological topics, such as Trends in Food Science and Technology and Trends in Polymer Science. However, these non-biological titles were later discontinued or removed from the series. In 2001, some journals underwent name changes. For example, Immunology Today became Trends in Immunology, Parasitology Today became Trends in Parasitology, and Molecular Medicine Today was renamed Trends in Molecular Medicine. Additionally, Drug Discovery Today was separated from the series and became an independent brand. Initially, the journals were published in Cambridge, UK, but the Trends Editorial Office relocated to London in the mid-1990s after Elsevier acquired Pergamon Press. The current lineup of Trends journals includes the following: 1. Trends in Biochemical Sciences (TIBS), established in 1976, focuses on biochemistry. 2. Trends in Biotechnology, launched in 1983, covers topics in biotechnology. 3. Trends in Cell Biology, introduced in 1991, specializes in cell biology. 4. Trends in Cognitive Sciences, started in 1997, addresses cognitive science. 5. Trends in Ecology & Evolution (TREE), founded in 1986, explores evolutionary ecology. 6. Trends in Endocrinology and Metabolism, initiated in 1990, focuses on endocrinology and metabolism. This journal publishes ten issues per year, unlike the others, which are published monthly. 7. Trends in Genetics (TIG), established in 1985, covers genetics. 8. Trends in Immunology, previously known as Immunology Today, has been published since 1980 and focuses on immunology. 9. Trends in Microbiology (TIM), launched in 1993, specializes in microbiology. 10. Trends in Molecular Medicine, formerly Molecular Medicine Today, has been published since 1995 and focuses on molecular medicine. 11. Trends in Neurosciences (TINS), introduced in 1978, covers neuroscience. 12. Trends in Parasitology, previously called Parasitology Today, has been published since 1985 and focuses on parasitology. 13. Trends in Pharmacological Sciences (TIPS), established in 1979, addresses pharmacology. 14. Trends in Plant Science, launched in 1996, focuses on botany. All of these journals are published on a monthly basis, with the exception of Trends in Endocrinology and Metabolism, which releases ten issues annually.
